title: Japanese-Style Chicken Curry
description: A fusion dish that combines Japanese flavors with Indian spices. This curry is a hearty and comforting meal.
instructions: 1. Heat the sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add the diced onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
4. Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
5. Add the curry powder and stir to combine. Cook for 1 minute.
6. Pour in the zesty curry sauce and bring to a simmer.
7. Reduce heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
8. Stir in the coconut milk, if using.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onion.
